bootstrap_backoff.reason: An initial JitState or evaluator JitFlow allocation failure occurs before per-state cooldown storage exists.
bootstrap_backoff.policy: Use one process-level scalar backoff of 4096 eligible bootstrap allocation events following optional initial allocation or byte-reservation failure.
eligible_paths: Already warming ordinary CALL nomination requiring initial JitState
Real warming periodic backedge requiring initial JitState
Native CALL preparation requiring an absent evaluator JitFlow
bootstrap_backoff.existing_state_or_flow_fast_path: Bypass bootstrap backoff when the required state or flow already exists.
bootstrap_backoff.existing_compile_resource_backoff: Retain the separate per-state 4096 eligible-event cooldown.
bootstrap_backoff.error_behavior: Preserve actual errors and revalidate after callback-capable allocation or cleanup.
bootstrap_backoff.concurrency: Process scalar consumption and publication must use the project's atomic conventions.

observer_recovery_limit: Loop heads rearm after observation ends. A detached leaf can be nominated by a fresh ordinary CALL site; an already specialized caller has no new per-call lookup solely to renominate the leaf. This is an optimization-liveness limit, not permanent unsupported status.
byte_budget_scope: Charge retained Unit metadata, ops, offsets and rounded mapping, plus allocated JitState and evaluator JitFlow. Keep retired pinned artifacts charged until final free. Bounded compiler scratch is separate; 8 MiB is not an RSS cap.
